top_signal.title: I have an ex-employee who has gone full psycho and started bombing me with fake bad reviews. Help.
top_signal.summary: I hired someone at my restaurant in the spring. We’re small, and had just opened… so one person runs the show solo at that time. Meaning if someone doesn’t show up, the business is closed and losing money, and creating angry customers who come to see us and finds the doors locked. I was out of town and she was scheduled from 11am-8pm. I got a text that said (and I’m paraphrasing here) “because my college’s testing system was hacked, my professor had to move my final exam to tonight. If I don’t go, I fail the class. So I have to lockup and leave”.    Mind you, this was a Friday night, after 4pm when she “had to leave” to take this supposed final exam. So she left my restaurant, locked the doors, and went on her way. I wasn’t in town, so I couldn’t come cover the shift.    That night; I got a voice mail, an email; and two Facebook messages from several folks saying that they came to eat, and the doors were locked and all the lights were off. Potential customers were not happy. As you can imagine, I was rightfully upset.    I made a quick call to her college, and asked a general question like “is there any scenario where a professor would force students to come take a final, or fail the class; with less than six hours notice, on a Friday night?” The admin at the college said without knowing the specifics; that it was extremely unlikely but she couldn’t tell me specifics without violating privacy issues.
